source_snapshot.criteria: The E1.S update completes without issue and the active revision matches the image.

old_problem: The active review left all target/image/activation inputs as an engineering decision. NVMe standard and nvme-cli documentation define download versus commit/activation and action 1 at a selected slot, while the exact E1.S identity, EPK98B5Q compatibility and vendor rollback package are project prerequisites. These can safely parameterize the test without changing the flash or declaring hardware success.
disposition_reason: The nvme-cli authority confirms that firmware download only transfers the image and that commit action 1 replaces the selected slot and activates it on the next reset. ED-07 requires retaining Flash and pre/post version validation under independent authorization; ED-12 keeps update distinct from downgrade; ED-15 forbids PASS without the vendor image/revision oracle; ED-18 requires each complete OFF-to-ON-to-OS-ready cycle. DeepSeek substitutions are rejected.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row432 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history3023 and adjacent row431 AMD SMI plus row433 E1.S detection cases.

Applied nvme-cli firmware-download and firmware-commit semantics: download does not apply the image, action 1 targets a selected slot for activation on the next reset, and reset/re-enumeration evidence is required.
Preserved EPK98B5Q.BIN, source action 1, source slot 2, the first power cycle, revision check, about-ten-second wait and second power cycle; no parameter is replaced by DeepSeek's generic values.
Made serial/model/controller/BDF/physical-slot identity, signed compatibility, non-boot/data protection and vendor recovery mandatory execution gates.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row433 and verified its manifest identity; no firmware download, activation, storage write, power cycle or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: E1.S EPK98B5Q slot-2 firmware update with staged activation and two controlled power-cycle validations
test_case.purpose: Update the exact approved E1.S controller with EPK98B5Q.BIN in firmware slot 2 using vendor-approved action-1 semantics and prove the intended revision, identity, namespace data and device health survive both required power cycles.
required_package: Serial/model/controller/namespace/BDF/physical-slot mapping for the exact non-boot E1.S target
Vendor-authorized EPK98B5Q.BIN, checksum/signature, release notes, model compatibility and expected active revision
Pinned nvme-cli version and vendor-approved mapping of source fw-activate action 1/slot 2 to that release's supported command
Backup or certified disposable/empty-device proof, data-integrity baseline and stable flash power
Approved two-cycle maintenance plan, OOB access, ten-second timing anchor and vendor rollback/recovery image/procedure
test_case.test_command: Resolve the placeholder only through serial/model/controller/BDF/slot evidence; prove it is not an OS/boot/EFI/swap/RAID/LVM/mounted or protected-data target. Capture `nvme id-ctrl`, firmware-slot log, SMART/error/namespace/PCIe state and data-integrity baseline. Verify EPK98B5Q.BIN hash/signature/compatibility. At an independent flash authorization hold point, download the image to the verified controller, confirm the staged slot, and issue only the vendor-approved semantic equivalent of source action 1 slot 2. Perform controlled power cycle 1 through complete OFF, ON, device re-enumeration and OS Ready; verify active revision. Wait the source's approximately 10 seconds from the approved anchor, perform controlled power cycle 2 through OS Ready, then reverify revision, identity, namespaces, data integrity and health.
test_case.expected_result: The exact approved controller accepts the complete image and reports slot-2 staging/commit success. After each complete power cycle it re-enumerates at the same identity and mapping, and after the second cycle the active revision exactly matches the vendor-declared EPK98B5Q revision. Namespaces/data, SMART/error, PCIe and system logs remain within the approved healthy baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires immutable target proof, authorized image and slot/action compatibility, backup/data baseline, complete download/commit records, both OFF-to-ON-to-OS-ready timelines, exact post-flash revision and unchanged namespace/data/health evidence. A successful transfer or revision string alone cannot pass. Missing vendor compatibility, rollback or cycle evidence is INCONCLUSIVE—not PASS.
safety_gate: Never select by mutable /dev namespace alone; independently exclude all boot, mounted, swap, RAID, LVM, device-mapper and protected-data targets
Require separate user authorization after showing exact serial/model, image hash, slot/action and recovery plan before any firmware write
Maintain stable power during download/commit and use only controlled approved power cycles with OOB observation
Abort on identity, compatibility, slot, health or power mismatch; preserve evidence and never auto-retry or substitute parameters
expected_evidence: Pre-flash revision, firmware-slot log, SMART/error/PCIe state and data-integrity baseline
EPK98B5Q hash/signature/release-note compatibility and independent flash approval
Exact download/stage/action-1-slot-2 command outputs and timestamps
Two complete power-cycle/re-enumeration timelines, active revision, post-data/health and rollback readiness
test_case.recovery: On target, download, commit, enumeration or health failure, stop before any next phase, preserve controller/image/power/log evidence and use OOB plus the vendor-approved recovery or rollback image only under a new explicit authorization. Do not issue another firmware command or power cycle automatically.
